# N7 maintenance: use the repaired coefficient owner

Repeated BLOCKED attempts were caused by `def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients` lacking a usable general common-stage
interface. Maintenance withdrew its readiness record in both DAGs and reopened the owner
through the normal bottom-up queue. This is not a compiler, permission or timeout defect.
Read `coord/reports/maintenance/N7-qbar-datum-free-interface.md` and both relevant `coord/repair-notes/` records after the shared base refreshes.

Resume this item only after the owner's new usable interface lands. Refresh the node and
read its active `lean` record; `lean_invalidation.previous_lean` is historical evidence.
Keep the arbitrary field K₀, l invertible in K₀, and the fixed compactification. A global
finite-field datum need not be related to Y, but that fact does not supply the absent datum
or a canonical datum-removal interface. Do not add D or narrow K₀ to a finite field.

Use the existing `sfCompactSupportTerm`, `sfCompactSupportTransition`,
`sfIntegralCompactSupport_constructible`, and unchanged-object rational category. Use the
new owner's actual pair category, not a sigma carrier; the output is the literal pair
`(E, Rf_! K_E)`. The derived-limit existence theorem has a complete proof; the old report's
earlier hollow-choice objection was corrected. The finite tower is indexed by n+1.
The rejected datum-bound and sigma-carrier drafts in scratchpad remain rejected. Refresh
any stale sandbox node copy, compile delivered files individually (60 seconds each), and
run the normal delivery dry run. No other DAG node belongs in this consumer delivery.
